mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Release the lock on an object after changing it.

description: Unlock operation. object_type required: CLASS(object_name*, lock_handle*), PROGRAM(object_name*, lock_handle*) [onprem only], INTERFACE(object_name*, lock_handle*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*, lock_handle*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name*, lock_handle*), TABLE(object_name*, lock_handle*), STRUCTURE(object_name*, lock_handle*), DDL(object_name*, lock_handle*), DOMAIN(object_name*, lock_handle*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*, lock_handle*), PACKAGE(object_name*, lock_handle*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*, lock_handle*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(object_name*, lock_handle*), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*, lock_handle*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(object_name*, lock_handle*), SERVICE_BINDING(object_name*, lock_handle*); an empty lock_handle of a SERVICE_BINDING answers that the binding is already unlocked. Over Streamable HTTP the unlock takes the lock's state_handle: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under the lock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header); the unlock ends the instance's hold on the lock. When object_type is one of CLASS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING; or object_type is PACKAGE and the connection is HTTP, recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

object_name.description: Object name. A function module is named GROUP|MODULE, its function group first.

object_type.description: Object type. Supported: CLASS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, PACKAGE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING.

name: HandlerUnlock
